title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto run into one chilling mystery after another: a neighbor dressed all in black, eyes watching from a cemetery, a red circle on a basement wall that changes each day (Viz blurb). Junji Ito adapts nine stories from the Shin Mimibukuro urban-legend collection, presented as 'scary stories that really happened' (Viz blurb). One volume.
life_message: The ordinary world hides unexplained terrors; the stories offer fear rather than a lesson.
